column1: # Starter manual table of resource-related GOVERNMENT REVENUE for source countries with no/thin EITI/GRD coverage.

column1: # Sources for every row are documented in docs/extractive/manual_resource_data_sources.md.
# total_resource_revenue_usd_bn = the source country's resource government revenue for that commodity-year, USD billions.
# frac_pre_profit / frac_post_profit / frac_equity sum to 1: pre = royalties/licence-fees/bonuses/production-entitlements (expensed, NOT in CbCR profit)

column2: equity = state dividends / state-participation income.

column1: # domestic_share = fraction attributed to the source country's own NOC/state firms (lands on the (parent==partner) CbCR cell)
